messages:
Olivia Park: FYI scheduling intake call w/ SpotCheckSec next Mon for the external pentest. They need scope + asset list by EOD Fri.
Ranjit Singh: Thanks — can we confirm scope includes RBAC, KMS integrations, audit logging, Dedicated pools, and the private control plane? Want to ensure they hit VPC paths.
Olivia Park: yep all of those. Add 'console rollouts' and 'model routing fallbacks' as high-risk items.
Mike Chen: tagging @DevOps Oncall — will you provide a read-only service account and token rotation notes? Vendor asked for temporary API keys scoped to read-only for logs/metrics.
DevOps Oncall: We can spin a short-lived role via STS. Need a list of exact principals they require and the allowed actions. Prefer to avoid creating long-lived keys.
Anna Lopez: I'll drop the intake spreadsheet link here: https://company.internal/sec/intake/1769501235
sec-intake-bot: Intake form submitted by Olivia Park. Generated JIRA: SEC-7891. Initial severity: TBD. (automated)
Ranjit Singh: SEC-7891 created, thanks bot. Assigning to Jared for triage and to Mike for infra access.
Jared Wu: I'll triage once I get the assets. Also please flag scope for KMS — if they request ciphertext samples we should only provide sanitized examples. No private key material.
Mike Chen: For KMS: vendor needs to test CMK usage patterns. We can create a customer-managed test key in staging and enable logging for encrypt/decrypt. I'll open INFRA-4523 with temp policy.
Olivia Park: Can we agree on remediation SLA tiers? Suggest Critical: 48h, High: 7 days, Medium: 30 days. Retest window offered within 7 days of remediation for Critical/High.
Ranjit Singh: Agree on SLAs + retest cadence. Also want an audit-log export for the pen test period (read-only) and a timeline for when logs are immutable.
Anna Lopez: Quick visibility: added columns to SEC-7891: "finder", "affected-svc", "remediation-owner", "status", "fix-by", "retest-requested". Example row:
```
SEC-7891-001, credentials-exposure, console-auth, Mike Chen, open, 2026-06-02, no
```
Mike Chen: I'll update INFRA-4523 with the temp role, posting the policy snippet here:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:GetLogEvents","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:...:log-group:pen-test-*"}]
}
```
Jared Wu: Triage notes: top findings to look for = RBAC over-perm, missing audit markers on service-to-service, KMS key policy too permissive. I'll attach repro steps in SEC-7891.
DevOps Oncall: Reminder: we will rotate any temporary creds immediately after retest window closes. Also we need to schedule a canary traffic run for the Dedicated cluster to surface rate-limit issues.
Olivia Park: Planning checklist for next steps:
- finalize asset inventory (Anna)
- create temp infra roles + policies (Mike)
- triage incoming report items + map to SEC tickets (Jared)
- confirm retest SLA + vendor retest window (Ranjit)
- prepare audit-log export path and retention notes (DevOps)

Can everyone add ETA in SEC-7891 by EOD tomorrow?
Ranjit Singh: I'll coordinate retest window w/ SpotCheckSec. Proposing 2026-06-09 to 2026-06-12 as tentative.
Anna Lopez: Added ETAs for asset list and intake details.
Mike Chen: INFRA-4523 created and linked in SEC-7891. ETA for roles = 2 business days.
Jared Wu: I'll start triage as soon as vendor shares PoC. Will flag Critical issues on Slack and update ticket.
Olivia Park: thanks team. If any blocker, ping me or escalate to @Ranjit. Closing thread unless new updates. :thumbsup:
